selection_rule: Among visible first 1000 GitHub original source directory contents, filter STC_XXXX.smt2 4-digit source names; EXCLUDE previously opened STC_0003/0004/0005/0006/0013/0014/0228/0268/0291/0588/0609/0786/0813/0880/0087/0795; sort the remaining source Git blob SHA1 ASCII ascending; take first 12. No target-content/status/solvability selection, though filename RHS is public metadata.
source_split: first_body_unopened_12_git_sha_blobs; NOT blind filename RHS; same already studied STC published author-family, no new cross-family author transfer

preregistered_policy.parser: Exact native original source single assertion x^3+y^3+z^3=N over three distinct Int symbols, no other original constraints. Reject malformed source; retain all.
preregistered_policy.first_stage: Finite unbounded integer UNSAT mod9 if target residue 4 or5, certificate independent Z3+cvc5 QF_LIA abstract plus verified exact source AST. If YES stop.
preregistered_policy.second_stage: If not mod9 impossible, use fixed exact CRT15561 radius10000 with 9×7×13×19 cube residues, sorted pair binary search; source-derived N, no answer labels, SAT ONLY with raw original grounded unchanged SMT-LIB Z3+cvc5 independent. If no witness, report unbounded UNKNOWN.
preregistered_policy.direct_baselines: Same CPU and unchanged authentic original SMT2 source Z3 4-second and cvc5 4-second, independent; strongest of either accepted SAT/UNSAT ONLY if actual full original status certified. Raw solver UNKNOWN retained as timeout, not comparable unbounded UNSAT.
preregistered_policy.metrics: Number original source SAT and UNSAT from hybrid, direct union solved, hybrid-only statuses, new unknowns, whole source parse and independent proof cost (do not include raw Direct time in hybrid arm). 12 original preserved.
preregistered_policy.fairness: Mathematical mod9 obstruction and CRT15561 specialist methods are available to equally authorized Direct; do not claim novel NEUMANN architecture/learned model, only a source-conditioned classical mechanism vs **raw** generic Z3/cvc5. This is NOT comparison to strongest specialist.
preregistered_policy.unseen_claim: Source bytes unseen at registration, but source names leak numerical RHS, family STC math known, author-family generalization absent.
